name: prof-f03-apple — extracted from f03-apple
palette: Pure black-and-white with high contrast; occasional grain and low contrast in documentary shots to signal authenticity; white text on black for titles.
light_logic: Simple, directional key light for portraits; natural daylight for outdoor faces; minimal fill to preserve shadows; strong separation of subject from dark backgrounds.
lens: Mostly close and extreme close-up portraits with occasional medium shots; slightly longer focal lengths for intimate faces; stable, composed frames with archival feel.
texture: Film grain, slight softness, and archival imperfections; clean, uncluttered compositions; minimal graphic elements beyond logo and tagline.
world: A timeless, placeless black-and-white world where historical figures and everyday streets coexist; spaces are implied rather than showcased, keeping focus on human faces and gestures.
forbidden: busy on-screen graphics or kinetic typography
rapid, flashy cutting or camera moves
overt product shots or UI demos
noisy sound design that competes with the voiceover
